categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Hengli Hydraulic Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the manufacturing of high-pressure hydraulic cylinders, hydraulic components including pumps, valves, motors, and hydraulic systems. The company also engages in precision casting, mechanical equipment manufacturing, and provides related technical support services. Its products serve sectors such as construction machinery, industrial equipment, marine engineering, and new energy equipment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes advanced hydraulic transmission and control technologies, including high-pressure heavy-duty pumps and valves, servo hydraulic cylinders, and integrated hydraulic systems. It utilizes precision casting, heat treatment, and digital hydraulic control technologies. The firm has developed proprietary technologies such as integrated power take-off and high-pressure heavy-duty pumps, and focuses on digital, electric, and intelligent hydraulic solutions.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include domestic and international construction machinery manufacturers, industrial equipment producers, marine engineering firms, and new energy equipment manufacturers. The company supplies major excavator manufacturers and OEMs in China and overseas markets, including Europe, North America, Japan, and Southeast Asia. Its products are used in excavators, aerial work platforms, shield machines, offshore wind power, and industrial automation.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Changzhou, Jiangsu Province. It has established subsidiaries and offices in Japan, the United States, Germany, Hong Kong, India, Mexico, Indonesia, France, Brazil, and Singapore, supporting a global sales and service network. Overseas sales accounted for approximately 22% of total revenue, reflecting a growing international presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangsu Hengli Hydraulic operates mainly in the midstream segment of the hydraulic equipment supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and assembly of core hydraulic components and systems. It supplies these components directly to OEMs and end equipment manufacturers, playing a critical role in the upstream supply of hydraulic parts for heavy machinery and industrial applications.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment in digital, electric, and intelligent hydraulic technologies, including servo hydraulic cylinders, electronic pumps with triple closed-loop control, and linear actuators. It aims to break technological bottlenecks in high-pressure heavy-duty hydraulic components and expand product lines to meet diversified industry demands. The firm also focuses on global market expansion, production capacity enhancement, and talent development to support innovation and internationalization.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of hydraulic products including cylinders, pumps, valves, motors, and integrated hydraulic systems. The company also earns income from precision casting and mechanical parts sales, as well as providing technical support and after-sales services. Revenue streams include domestic and international product sales to OEMs and industrial clients.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include international hydraulic component manufacturers such as Rexroth, Kawasaki, Parker, Danfoss, and Japanese firms like KYB. Jiangsu Hengli Hydraulic positions itself as a leading domestic high-end hydraulic equipment supplier with a focus on innovation, quality, and international market penetration. It aims to replace imports in China and expand its global footprint, leveraging technological breakthroughs and brand reputation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved record revenue of approximately RMB 9.39 billion, a 4.51% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 2.51 billion, a slight increase of 0.40%. Total assets reached RMB 19.64 billion, up 9.74%, and shareholders' equity was RMB 15.77 billion, up 9.61%. The company maintains steady growth supported by expanding market share, especially in excavator hydraulic pumps and valves, and increasing overseas sales.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jiangsu Hengli Hydraulic emphasizes high-quality, technologically advanced hydraulic components with proprietary innovations that break foreign monopolies in large-scale hydraulic cylinders. Its products feature high reliability, precision, and integration capabilities, supported by extensive R&D and global manufacturing standards. The company offers localized, efficient service networks worldwide and focuses on electric and intelligent hydraulic solutions to meet evolving customer needs in construction, industrial, and new energy sectors.
